text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I saw two girls laying out
a mountain of cheap penny candy across a table...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, would you care to join us, Trainer?
It is the "Princesses' Dagashi Party," after all♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, when Fine-san and I were young,
our dream was to stuff our bellies full
of cheap penny candy...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Still, they never let me back home,
so why not make it come true right now~?☆
Japanese junk food looks super delicious too~♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"How nostalgic♪
When I was little, I used to run to the candy store every day."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Going out shopping beyond the castle walls at such a young age...!
That's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ The shopping district is my backyard!
I used to stride through it with a 10-yen coin tightly in hand!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Learning how to budget while interacting with the townspeople...
that sounds wonderful too!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-chan is really so reliable...
I really look up to her~♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, being praised so much makes me blush...!
Both my mood and appetite are shooting through the roof!
choice_data_list: No working up a huge appetite, that's strictly forbidden!
Let's eat as much as we want!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ugh, indeed overeating is not good...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu!
My maid used to tell me the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my!
In our house, Mother would strike us down with lightning herself~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the princess talk became lively, and they enjoyed some cheap sweets in moderation.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Naturally~~!
To be a princess is to eat well and laugh heartily!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! I think so too♪
I've gotta get to know all the delicious foods across the country.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll binge-eat until my stomach
is bursting at the seams~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The cheap candy party was a blast, and we stuffed ourselves to our hearts' content.
